### [6] "Building LangGraph" Design Blog Post

- **Tier:** 2 (manufacturer blog)

### [13] Grid Dynamics: LangGraph to Temporal Migration

- **URL:** https://temporal.io/blog/prototype-to-prod-ready-agentic-ai-grid-dynamics
- **Author:** Temporal team / Grid Dynamics
- **Tier:** 2 (manufacturer case study)
- **Data extracted:** Redis-based state management was brittle (lifecycle/expiration issues, cache corruption, expensive debugging), thousands of lines of custom retry code, Kafka for exactly-once processing caused race conditions/stale state/stuck agents, custom worker scaling per application; Temporal benefits: state as workflow variables (eliminates Redis), declarative RetryPolicy, stateless workers with Kubernetes scaling, event-sourced durability; activity decoupling required converting nodes to self-contained activities with serializable I/O; client pooling/lazy initialization for efficiency
